risk_description: The fastenings on the rear axle are tightened with incorrect torques. This may lead to loosening of connections, deterioration in braking performance, loss of control over the vehicle and even to a loss of a wheel, thereby endangering the surrounding traffic.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
